summary: GLM-5.3 starts with decode context parallelism under online quantization
compatibility: No user action required. Launches at DCP1 or without --quantization-config are unchanged.
details: Online quantization builds the attention weights on the meta device, and the MLA DCP exchange took its device from them, so DCP > 1 with --quantization-config failed at load with 'SymmetricMemory does not support device type meta'. The exchange buffers now go to the rank's GPU.
GLM-5.3-NVFP4-CSF at TP8 with online MXFP8 attention and shared experts starts at DCP2 (1,217,792 KV tokens, full 1M context) and DCP8 (4,858,368 KV tokens) over the B12X PCIe DCP exchange.
